conf.description: Trellix ePO HIPS intrusion, syslog-cef: CEF header + fixed-order extension-key regex_extract (own extension stage, disjoint from the threat envelope), Direction-aware network field resolution, severity invert, AppHash digest-length probe; keeps _raw per recommendations (IDS-class forensic value).

conf.comment: trellix-epo/hips-intrusion/syslog-cef. HIPS shares the CEF pipe-delimited header shape with the threat-event pipeline but has its OWN, disjoint extension key set (signature/connection keys, not the malware ThreatName/AnalyzerName envelope) -- this work order's field table lists no DetectedUTC/ReceivedUTC for this dataset, unlike ens-threat/device-control, so none is assumed present here. No timestamp column is attested at all, so _time falls back to best-effort auto_timestamp on _raw (README gap). Direction is consulted before LocalPort/RemotePort become source/destination.port, per recommendations.direct.cribl, rather than the ArcSight-era assumption that the local host is always source. AppHash's digest length is probed to type it when possible, keeping the raw value in the vendor namespace regardless. Keeps _raw per recommendations (IDS-class records are forensic).

conf.regex: /CEF:\d+\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|SignatureID=(?<SignatureID>.*?) SignatureName=(?<SignatureName>.*?) SigRuleClass=(?<SigRuleClass>.*?) ThreatEventID=(?<ThreatEventID>.*?) EventPolicyType=(?<EventPolicyType>.*?) ThreatSeverity=(?<ThreatSeverity>.*?) ThreatAction=(?<ThreatAction>.*?) Direction=(?<Direction>.*?) LocalIPAddress=(?<LocalIPAddress>.*?) LocalPort=(?<LocalPort>.*?) RemotePort=(?<RemotePort>.*?) NetworkProtocol=(?<NetworkProtocol>.*?) ThreatSourceIPv4=(?<ThreatSourceIPv4>.*?) ThreatSourceHostName=(?<ThreatSourceHostName>.*?) ProcessName=(?<ProcessName>.*?) AppHash=(?<AppHash>.*?) AppSigner=(?<AppSigner>.*?) EventUserName=(?<EventUserName>.*?) DetectingProductName=(?<DetectingProductName>.*?) DetectingProductHostName=(?<DetectingProductHostName>\S*)$/

functions.description: split the CEF pipe-delimited header (discarded) from the HIPS signature/connection extension key=value pairs, bounding each value by the next literal key name
best-effort timestamp detection; no timestamp column is attested for this dataset/format in the work order
invert severity, derive outcome from ThreatAction, resolve Direction-dependent network fields, probe AppHash digest length before it is renamed
batch-rename status:mapped/straightforward extension fields to their ECS or vendor-namespace target
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
